articles.title: Gemini taps SpaceXAI to build a personalized prediction markets feed
articles.snippet: The new feature integrates SpaceXAI models to deliver real-time market intelligence, personalized signals and portfolio insights directly inside the Gemini app.

articles.title: Bit Digital bought $20 million ETH for first time since October before 15% plunge
articles.snippet: The firm said it purchased 8,568 ether on May 11 at an average price of $2,334. Since then, ETH broke below $2,000, leaving the firm sitting at a $3 million unrealized loss.

articles.title: P2P.org launches real-time data stream for Sui and Hyperliquid
articles.snippet: P2P.org, a blockchain infrastructure provider operating validators across 40+ proof-of-stake networks since 2018, today launched Syncro Data Stream, a real-time blockchain data stream for Sui and Hyperliquid.

articles.title: AI Chatbots Could Quietly Pull Users Away From Reality, Researchers Warn
articles.snippet: Researchers warn that prolonged chatbot interactions could distort how some users experience reality and social connection.

articles.title: Huawei's New Benchmark Gives AI Agents Months of Your Life—Then Watches Them Fail
articles.snippet: Claw-Anything simulates a real digital existence and asks AI assistants to handle it. GPT-5.5, the best model available, scored 34.5%.
